editorial:
Four grown friends who feel stuck get a wild second chance when a hot tub sends them back to 1986. Adam is fresh from a breakup, Lou is still chasing parties, Nick is worn down by marriage, and Jacob is glued to video games. The movie mixes silly jokes with a fun time-travel twist, so you get both heart and chaos. It feels like a rowdy weekend with old buddies, full of bad decisions, big laughs, and a surprising amount of heart.

The cast keeps the energy high, and the 80s setting gives you plenty to smile at, from music to fashion. Some jokes are crude and not every gag lands, but the pace rarely slows. If you want a light, goofy escape, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for movie night.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the friends realize they can change their futures by fixing their past mistakes. Lou decides to stay in 1986 and build a better life, while Adam, Nick, and Jacob return to a present where their lives are much happier. The twist is that their choices create a new timeline, so the ending shows them enjoying success instead of the same old rut.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy time-travel comedies and 80s nostalgia.
